_comment: Component inventory for the OPC UA Local Discovery Server service.
This manifest belongs to THIS repository (OPCFoundation/UA-LDS) and
describes only what this repository produces and links. It is self-
contained: every path below is relative to this project root, and the
manifest renders to a standalone CycloneDX 1.6 SBOM that can be published
UA-LDS-Installers consumes this file to compose the SBOM for the installer
it ships. Do not add installer-owned components here - the installer
declares its own (ldsca.dll, the certificate generator, the MSI).
RULE: adding or bumping any shipped component requires updating this file

project.name: OPC UA Local Discovery Server
project.description: OPC UA Local Discovery Server service - endpoint registration and discovery.

components.name: opcualds.exe
components.notes: The discovery service, running as a Windows service and listening for OPC UA requests. The primary attack surface of any product that ships it.

components.name: dnssd.dll
components.notes: DNS-SD client shim. Incorporates the dns_sd API surface derived from Apple mDNSResponder, hence the dual license record.

components.name: OPC UA ANSI C Stack
components.notes: Parses OPC UA messages arriving from the network, in-process inside opcualds.exe. VENDORED SOURCE under stack/ - not a pinned external dependency, so no dependency scanner will detect it. Reduced-functionality stack, LDS use only. No CPE exists for this component. Predates the OPC UA ECC SecurityPolicies, so this service cannot negotiate them.

components.name: OpenSSL
components.notes: Crypto and PKI for the network-facing service, so advisories here are the ones most likely to be severe. Statically linked (built 'no-shared'), so a fix requires rebuilding and re-releasing rather than patching a shared library. The version and configuration are decided by whoever builds this project; the figure above is what UA-LDS-Installers currently supplies ('no-shared no-asm no-autoload-config', with EC enabled for the OPC UA ECC policies).

components.name: Microsoft Visual C++ Runtime Library

licenses.name: Microsoft Visual C++ Runtime Library - proprietary, redistributable

components.notes: STATICALLY LINKED via /MT. A CRT vulnerability is therefore NOT remediated by Windows Update on the operator's machine - it requires a rebuild and re-release. Recorded as a shipped component rather than an environment assumption for that reason.
